title: Aura Bangladesh order
description: Canonical order after normalization. orders.py additionally validates catalog stock, regular prices, discount limits, geographic zones, delivery rates and arithmetic. ORDER_DRAFT is for review only; fulfillment accepts ORDER_CONFIRMED. Integration fields must originate from a trusted server, never the model.

address_line.description: Street/house or rural village/union/landmark details, not only a city or district.

remote_area.description: Merchant/courier verification is required. Only OUTSIDE_DHAKA; true selects the ৳150 rate.

items.description: Product IDs must be unique. unit_price_bdt is the catalog regular price; discounts belong in pricing_summary.

discount_applied_bdt.description: No more than floor(subtotal_bdt / 10). The order-wide discount applies proportionally and must honor each product's catalog minimum unit price.

delivery_charge_bdt.description: Dhaka city 70; suburbs 100; outside 130; verified remote outside 150. Zero only without a product discount.

courier_partner.description: REDX is a valid selection but has no implemented adapter.

courier_metadata.description: Trusted merchant settings from courier serviceability data; model output must not supply these IDs.

messenger_last_interaction_at.description: Trusted timezone-aware ISO8601 timestamp used by Messenger policy checks.

confirmation_message.description: Confirmation text from a trusted application sender.
